nodes.label: Servers Screen — Infrastructure Module
nodes.description: Infrastructure Servers monitoring page showing 4 servers. Columns: Name, Status (degraded/offline badge), CPU%, MEM%, DISK%, Region, Last Ping. Actions: Add Server, Remove per row. 3 servers degraded, 1 offline (prod-worker-01 at 91.7% memory triggering the global alert banner). Top alert bar references this server.

nodes.label: Infrastructure Module — Servers, Databases, Websites, Files
nodes.description: The Infrastructure section of the Vencore platform encompassing Servers, Databases, Websites, and Files navigation items visible in the sidebar across infrastructure screenshots.

nodes.label: Global Alert Banner Component
nodes.description: A persistent amber/yellow alert banner displayed at the top of all screens showing active system alerts. Visible across all 5 screenshots. Shows alert count (3 alerts), primary alert message, and a 'View alerts' link on the right. References prod-worker-01 memory critical threshold.
